claim: On the Next a game or ISR write to port 7FFD can remap the MMU slots holding hook code or a hook stack, so use a slot the write does not reset and check ROM and paging state at hook entry and exit.

evidence.text: Return (8F4E) maps the hook page back because a 7FFD write maps ROM over slot 1.
An IM 2 handler that writes 7FFD resets MMU 0, 1, 6 and 7; a hook window into another bank must use another slot (slot 2 used).
7FFD writes replace MMU1 so a private stack there is lost; a stack in a spare page in MMU2 survived.
A wrapper mapping slot 1 to ROM crashed when the hook stack was in slot 1; restore what was found.
A 7FFD write inside w_go put ROM back into MMU slot 0: 51 characters printed for 18 and updates ran 3 frames long; the verifier now models the reset.
